decision: ran Linux readonly shells through bubblewrap directly with a generated seccomp filter (bwrap --seccomp) instead of sandbox-runtime's apply-seccomp helper

result: readonly git log works here; writes, TCP, and AF_UNIX refused

decision: kept sandbox-runtime (Seatbelt) on macOS unchanged

decision: verified with real sockets, a TCP listener, git, and three mutants
